title: การแข่งขันฟิสิกส์โอลิมปิกระดับชาติ ครั้งที่ 12 (TPhO 2556)
subject: ฟิสิกส์
level: โอลิมปิก (สอวน.)
note: 21 items: 17 from the three theory problems and 4 theory parts of the experiment with synthetic data. The folder has no theory solution, so every theory answer was derived here and checked by an independent route; the lab answers agree with tpho_12_exp_solution.pdf except its part 5 unit (0.13 T should be 0.133 G).

items.title: อัตราเร็วแนว Y ของท่อนไม้ที่ถูกดีด
items.source: 1.1 ก: อัตราเร็วแนว Y ของท่อนไม้ที่ถูกดีด. Theory 1.1 (a) figure: angular momentum of CD about the hinge point C is unchanged by the hinge impulse, so (ml^2/3) w = -(m l u cos theta)/2 and CD's centre moves at v_x = (3/4) u sin theta cos theta, v_y = u (1 - (3/4) cos^2 theta). Adapted: theta (degrees) and u vary; returns v_y in m/s.
items.figure: Theory 1.1 (a) figure: angular momentum of CD about the hinge point C is unchanged by the hinge impulse, so (ml^2/3) w = -(m l u cos theta)/2 and CD's centre moves at v_x = (3/4) u sin theta cos theta, v_y = u (1 - (3/4) cos^2 theta). Adapted: theta (degrees) and u vary; returns v_y in m/s.

items.title: อัตราเร็วเชิงมุมของท่อนไม้ข้างที่ถูกดีด
items.source: 1.1 ข: อัตราเร็วเชิงมุมของท่อนไม้ข้างที่ถูกดีด. Theory 1.1 (b): about the hinge C, (ml^2/12) w + m (l/2)^2 w + m (l/2) u cos theta = 0, so CD turns at w = 3u cos theta/(2l). Adapted: theta (degrees), u and l vary; returns w in rad/s.
items.figure: Theory 1.1 (b): about the hinge C, (ml^2/12) w + m (l/2)^2 w + m (l/2) u cos theta = 0, so CD turns at w = 3u cos theta/(2l). Adapted: theta (degrees), u and l vary; returns w in rad/s.

items.title: การดลที่ใช้ดีดท่อนไม้สามท่อน
items.source: 1.1 ค: การดลที่ใช้ดีดท่อนไม้สามท่อน. Theory 1.1 (c): the jerk's impulse is the total momentum, m u + 2 m v_y = (3/2) m u (1 + sin^2 theta). Adapted: m, u and theta (degrees) vary; returns the impulse in N s.
items.figure: Theory 1.1 (c): the jerk's impulse is the total momentum, m u + 2 m v_y = (3/2) m u (1 + sin^2 theta). Adapted: m, u and theta (degrees) vary; returns the impulse in N s.

items.title: แรงจากความดันอากาศด้านหน้าอุกกาบาต
items.source: 1.2 ก: แรงจากความดันอากาศด้านหน้าอุกกาบาต. Theory 1.2 (a): air brought to rest in front of the meteor gains pressure (1/2) rho v^2 (Bernoulli), pushing on the cross-section pi r^2 with F = (1/2) rho v^2 pi r^2. Adapted: rho, v (km/s) and r vary; returns F in newtons.
items.figure: Theory 1.2 (a): air brought to rest in front of the meteor gains pressure (1/2) rho v^2 (Bernoulli), pushing on the cross-section pi r^2 with F = (1/2) rho v^2 pi r^2. Adapted: rho, v (km/s) and r vary; returns F in newtons.

items.title: ความเร่งของอุกกาบาตจากแรงต้าน
items.source: 1.2 ข: ความเร่งของอุกกาบาตจากแรงต้าน. Theory 1.2 (b): the drag C_d (1/2) rho v^2 pi r^2 decelerates the meteor at a = C_d rho v^2 pi r^2/(2m). Adapted: C_d, rho, v (km/s), r and m vary; returns the deceleration in m/s^2.
items.figure: Theory 1.2 (b): the drag C_d (1/2) rho v^2 pi r^2 decelerates the meteor at a = C_d rho v^2 pi r^2/(2m). Adapted: C_d, rho, v (km/s), r and m vary; returns the deceleration in m/s^2.

items.note: C_d, rho, v, r and m vary.

items.title: ค่าคงที่ในสมการความเร็วของอุกกาบาต
items.source: 1.2 ค: ค่าคงที่ในสมการความเร็วของอุกกาบาต. Theory 1.2 (c): dv/dt = -sin(theta) v dv/dz equals -C_d rho0 e^(-alpha z) pi r^2 v^2/(2m); integrating from v = u high up gives v = u exp(a e^(bz)) with a = -C_d rho0 pi r^2/(2 m alpha sin theta), b = -alpha. Adapted: C_d, r, m and theta (degrees) vary, rho0 = 1.2 kg/m^3, alpha = 1/(8 km); returns a.
items.figure: Theory 1.2 (c): dv/dt = -sin(theta) v dv/dz equals -C_d rho0 e^(-alpha z) pi r^2 v^2/(2m); integrating from v = u high up gives v = u exp(a e^(bz)) with a = -C_d rho0 pi r^2/(2 m alpha sin theta), b = -alpha. Adapted: C_d, r, m and theta (degrees) vary, rho0 = 1.2 kg/m^3, alpha = 1/(8 km); returns a.

items.title: ความสูงที่อุกกาบาตสว่างที่สุด
items.source: 1.2 ง: ความสูงที่อุกกาบาตสว่างที่สุด. Theory 1.2 (d): the meteor shines brightest where it loses kinetic energy fastest, the power C_d (1/2) rho v^3 pi r^2; with v = u exp(-A e^(-alpha z)) and A = C_d rho0 pi r^2/(2 m alpha sin theta), rho v^3 peaks where e^(-alpha z) = 1/(3A), so z_max = (1/alpha) ln(3A). Adapted: C_d, r, m and theta (degrees) vary, rho0 = 1.2 kg/m^3, alpha = 1/(8 km); returns z_max in km.
items.figure: Theory 1.2 (d): the meteor shines brightest where it loses kinetic energy fastest, the power C_d (1/2) rho v^3 pi r^2; with v = u exp(-A e^(-alpha z)) and A = C_d rho0 pi r^2/(2 m alpha sin theta), rho v^3 peaks where e^(-alpha z) = 1/(3A), so z_max = (1/alpha) ln(3A). Adapted: C_d, r, m and theta (degrees) vary, rho0 = 1.2 kg/m^3, alpha = 1/(8 km); returns z_max in km.

items.title: ความดันที่อุกกาบาตต้องทนได้
items.source: 1.2 จ: ความดันที่อุกกาบาตต้องทนได้. Theory 1.2 (e): at z_max the density is rho0/(3A) and the speed u e^(-1/3), so the stagnation pressure is (1/2) rho v^2 = rho0 u^2 e^(-2/3)/(6A) = m alpha u^2 sin(theta) e^(-2/3)/(3 C_d pi r^2). Adapted: C_d, r, m, theta (degrees) and u (km/s) vary; returns the pressure in MPa.
items.figure: Theory 1.2 (e): at z_max the density is rho0/(3A) and the speed u e^(-1/3), so the stagnation pressure is (1/2) rho v^2 = rho0 u^2 e^(-2/3)/(6A) = m alpha u^2 sin(theta) e^(-2/3)/(3 C_d pi r^2). Adapted: C_d, r, m, theta (degrees) and u (km/s) vary; returns the pressure in MPa.

items.title: ความดันสุดท้ายในกระบอกสูบสปริง
items.source: 2 ก: ความดันสุดท้ายในกระบอกสูบสปริง. Theory 2 (a) figure: the gas stops flowing when B's pressure equals A's, which the weight on A's light piston fixes at P_B = mg/a in the vacuum around the cylinders. Adapted: m (kg) and a (cm^2) vary; returns P_B in kPa with g = 9.8.
items.figure: Theory 2 (a) figure: the gas stops flowing when B's pressure equals A's, which the weight on A's light piston fixes at P_B = mg/a in the vacuum around the cylinders. Adapted: m (kg) and a (cm^2) vary; returns P_B in kPa with g = 9.8.

items.source: 2 ข: ปริมาตรก๊าซในกระบอกสูบสปริง. Theory 2 (b): B's piston stops where the spring holds the gas pressure, k x = (mg/a) a, so V_B = a x = mga/k. Adapted: m (kg), a (cm^2) and k vary; returns V_B in cm^3 with g = 9.8.
items.figure: Theory 2 (b): B's piston stops where the spring holds the gas pressure, k x = (mg/a) a, so V_B = a x = mga/k. Adapted: m (kg), a (cm^2) and k vary; returns V_B in cm^3 with g = 9.8.

items.title: งานที่แรงกดทำต่อก๊าซที่ถูกถ่ายเท
items.source: 2 ค-ง: งานที่แรงกดทำต่อก๊าซที่ถูกถ่ายเท. Theory 2 (c)-(d): the moved gas filled V_B T_A/T_B in A at pressure mg/a, so the weight did W_A = (mg/a) V_B T_A/T_B on it; with V_B = mga/k and T_B/T_A = 2 gamma/(gamma + 1), W_A = m^2 g^2 (gamma + 1)/(2 gamma k). Adapted: m (kg), k and gamma vary; returns W_A in joules with g = 9.8.
items.figure: Theory 2 (c)-(d): the moved gas filled V_B T_A/T_B in A at pressure mg/a, so the weight did W_A = (mg/a) V_B T_A/T_B on it; with V_B = mga/k and T_B/T_A = 2 gamma/(gamma + 1), W_A = m^2 g^2 (gamma + 1)/(2 gamma k). Adapted: m (kg), k and gamma vary; returns W_A in joules with g = 9.8.

items.source: 2 ฉ: พลังงานภายในที่เปลี่ยนไปของก๊าซที่ถูกถ่ายเท. Theory 2 (f): the moved gas gains internal energy W_A - W_B = m^2 g^2/(2 gamma k). Adapted: m (kg), k and gamma vary; returns the change in joules with g = 9.8.

items.title: อุณหภูมิก๊าซหลังการถ่ายเท
items.source: 2 ช: อุณหภูมิก๊าซหลังการถ่ายเท. Theory 2 (g): with U = PV/(gamma - 1), energy balance gives P V_B/(gamma - 1)(1 - T_A/T_B) = P V_B (T_A/T_B - 1/2), so T_B/T_A = 2 gamma/(gamma + 1); 7/6 for gamma = 1.4. Adapted: T_A (K) and gamma vary; returns T_B in kelvin.
items.figure: Theory 2 (g): with U = PV/(gamma - 1), energy balance gives P V_B/(gamma - 1)(1 - T_A/T_B) = P V_B (T_A/T_B - 1/2), so T_B/T_A = 2 gamma/(gamma + 1); 7/6 for gamma = 1.4. Adapted: T_A (K) and gamma vary; returns T_B in kelvin.

items.title: มุมตกกระทบที่ให้รุ้งสว่างที่สุด
items.source: 3 ข-ง: มุมตกกระทบที่ให้รุ้งสว่างที่สุด. Theory 3 (b)-(d) figure: d(alpha) = 2(N + 1) d(phi) - 2 d(theta) vanishes for the brightest light, so d(phi)/d(theta) = 1/(N + 1); with Snell's law this gives cos^2 theta = (n^2 - 1)/((N + 1)^2 - 1). Adapted: n and N vary; returns theta in degrees.
items.figure: Theory 3 (b)-(d) figure: d(alpha) = 2(N + 1) d(phi) - 2 d(theta) vanishes for the brightest light, so d(phi)/d(theta) = 1/(N + 1); with Snell's law this gives cos^2 theta = (n^2 - 1)/((N + 1)^2 - 1). Adapted: n and N vary; returns theta in degrees.

items.title: มุมของรุ้งปฐมภูมิ
items.source: 3 ก, จ-ซ: มุมของรุ้งปฐมภูมิ. Theory 3 (a), (e), (g), (h): for one internal reflection alpha = 4 phi - 2 theta, largest at the bright incidence cos^2 theta = (n^2 - 1)/3: 42.5 degrees for n = 1.33 (theta = 59.6, phi = 40.4), so primary-bow light leaves at 0 to 42.5 degrees and the sky inside the bow is brighter. Adapted: n varies; returns alpha in degrees.
items.figure: Theory 3 (a), (e), (g), (h): for one internal reflection alpha = 4 phi - 2 theta, largest at the bright incidence cos^2 theta = (n^2 - 1)/3: 42.5 degrees for n = 1.33 (theta = 59.6, phi = 40.4), so primary-bow light leaves at 0 to 42.5 degrees and the sky inside the bow is brighter. Adapted: n varies; returns alpha in degrees.

items.title: มุมของรุ้งทุติยภูมิ
items.source: 3 ฌ-ฎ: มุมของรุ้งทุติยภูมิ. Theory 3 (i)-(k): for two internal reflections alpha = 6 phi - 2 theta - pi, extreme at cos^2 theta = (n^2 - 1)/8: |alpha| = 50.1 degrees for n = 1.33 (theta = 71.9, phi = 45.6); between 42.5 and 50.1 degrees neither bow sends light, Alexander's dark band. Adapted: n varies; returns |alpha| in degrees.

Adapted: n varies; returns |alpha| in degrees.

items.title: โมเมนต์แม่เหล็กจากการแกว่งแบบบิด
items.source: Lab part 2: โมเมนต์แม่เหล็กจากการแกว่งแบบบิด. Lab part 2: twisting alone, the paired disc magnets (total mass m, radius R, thickness d) have I = mR^2/4 + md^2/12 and f = (1/2 pi) sqrt(mu B_h/I), so mu = I (2 pi f)^2/B_h; 50 swings in 33.97 s give f = 1.47 Hz, I = 1.435e-6 kg m^2 and mu = 3.0 A m^2 with B_h = 0.41 G. Adapted: the time for 50 swings and B_h (G) vary; returns mu in A m^2.

Adapted: the time for 50 swings and B_h (G) vary; returns mu in A m^2.

items.title: ความยาวเชือกที่คาบลูกตุ้มเท่าคาบการบิด
items.source: Lab part 3: ความยาวเชือกที่คาบลูกตุ้มเท่าคาบการบิด. Lab part 3: T_pendulum^2 is proportional to the string length, so a line through the origin (least squares) gives the slope; the length at which the pendulum period equals the torsion period T_t is l_m = T_t^2/slope (0.46/0.0381 = 12 cm in the solution). Adapted with synthetic periods (cm, s) and the torsion time for 50 swings; returns l_m in cm.

Adapted with synthetic periods (cm, s) and the torsion time for 50 swings; returns l_m in cm.

items.title: สนามแม่เหล็กโลกแนวดิ่งจากการแกว่งคู่ควบ
items.source: Lab parts 4-5: สนามแม่เหล็กโลกแนวดิ่งจากการแกว่งคู่ควบ. Lab part 5: inverting tau_max = (B_h/B_v)(1/f_t)(2 l_max/sqrt(R^2 + d^2/3)) gives B_v = B_h 2 l_max/(tau_max f_t sqrt(R^2 + d^2/3)); tau_max = 35 s, f_t = 1.47 Hz, l_max = 12.0 cm, B_h = 0.41 G give 0.133 G (the solution prints 0.13 T, a unit slip for 1.3e-5 T). Adapted: tau_max, f_t, l_max and B_h vary; returns B_v in gauss.
items.figure: Lab part 5: inverting tau_max = (B_h/B_v)(1/f_t)(2 l_max/sqrt(R^2 + d^2/3)) gives B_v = B_h 2 l_max/(tau_max f_t sqrt(R^2 + d^2/3)); tau_max = 35 s, f_t = 1.47 Hz, l_max = 12.0 cm, B_h = 0.41 G give 0.133 G (the solution prints 0.13 T, a unit slip for 1.3e-5 T). Adapted: tau_max, f_t, l_max and B_h vary; returns B_v in gauss.
